stages.nameZh: 打基础 · Vibe Coding 入门
stages.descZh: 先用提示词把原型跑起来，理解 AI 代码的边界——能做什么、会在哪里翻车。
stages.descEn: Get prototypes running with prompts first, and learn where AI code breaks — what it can do and where it fails.

stages.descZh: 把架构约束、规格与相关文件喂给 AI，让它在正确的上下文里一次写对，减少臆测与返工。
stages.descEn: Feed AI your architecture constraints, specs and relevant files so it writes correctly on the first pass, cutting guesswork and rework.

stages.descZh: 用规划优先、测试驱动与子代理分工，让 Agent 自主完成更大、更可靠的任务。
stages.descEn: Use plan-first, test-driven and subagent division of labor to let agents complete bigger, more reliable tasks.

stages.descZh: 上线前的打磨清单：测试、错误处理、性能、安全与可维护性，让代码真正可交付。
stages.descEn: A pre-launch polish checklist — tests, error handling, performance, security and maintainability — so the code actually ships.

categories.descZh: 从零开始的 Vibe Coding 教程与课程，中英文都有。
